channel.title: StepHaven Journal
channel.description: Walking projects, player guides and notes from the making of StepHaven.

item.title: StepHaven Build Planner
item.description: Plan a lamplit bench, a gnome garden or a dog yard in StepHaven. See what each build costs in steps, check off the pieces you own and share a plan with a friend.

item.title: A walking game that won't make you feel guilty
item.description: StepHaven has no streaks to lose, no energy timers and no ads. Miss a few days and every step you walked still counts. Here's how it stays gentle.

item.title: StepHaven vs Pikmin Bloom: which walking game suits you?
item.description: Both turn your steps into a gentle game. Pikmin Bloom is played on the walk, with Pikmin and flowers on a real map. StepHaven is played after it, building your own town. An honest side-by-side.

item.title: Games like Pikmin Bloom for iPhone, but you build a town
item.description: Like Pikmin Bloom's gentle walking but want something to build? StepHaven turns your steps into a cozy town. Plus Pokémon GO, Pixel Islands, MistyWay, Walkr and Fogbreaker, sorted by what you like about Pikmin Bloom.

item.title: A cozy game for iPhone that you play by walking
item.description: Looking for a cozy game that also gets you outside? StepHaven is a gentle town builder for iPhone where your steps become cottages, gardens, trains and boats. No ads, no timers.

item.title: Your first week in StepHaven: a beginner's guide
item.description: How your steps become points, what to build first, the daily present, the visitors who come to town and the Workshop.

item.title: Walking games for iPhone, honestly compared
item.description: Pikmin Bloom, Pokémon GO, Walkr, Zombies, Run! and five more iPhone walking games: what each is, who it suits, how it counts your steps and what it costs.

item.title: Seasons, sunsets and full moons in StepHaven
item.description: How StepHaven follows your phone's clock and the real calendar: times of day, weather, seasons and the full-moon fair.

item.title: A cozy town with no image files
item.description: How StepHaven draws a whole town in Core Graphics code, generates its world from a seed, and syncs shared towns over CloudKit with no server.

item.title: How StepHaven turns your steps into a town
item.description: How steps become points in StepHaven, what they buy, and why steps can never be bought.

item.title: Every kind of moving counts: wheelchair pushes and Ember workouts
item.description: Wheelchair pushes count like steps in StepHaven, and Ember turns workouts into points for your town.

item.title: A walking game where friends build one town together
item.description: How shared towns work in StepHaven: invites, who can change what, and what stays your own.
